verdict.rationale: The 01 is an agentic voice interface that executes code, browses the web and controls software, so plugging in MCP servers is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or attaching external tool servers. Generic "control third-party software" claims and profile customization are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
